name: Git Control
description: A Git client inside Orca, with AI: commit graph, commits, merges with a side-by-side conflict resolver, interactive rebase, stashes and worktrees, plus GitHub and GitLab merge requests (approve and merge) and every branch's pipelines, with your existing Git login. In a full tab and the right sidebar.

cover.alt: Git Control: a blue and lavender paper Git history sculpture with ivory commit nodes and revision cards on a dark studio backdrop
